mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and increase risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day windows where FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the 20-day windows where UNRATE is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is declining (indicating monetary easing) and the CPI rate is above 2.5% (indicating high inflation), the market perceives a 'stagflation' risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 0.25pp in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL > 2.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the 20-day windows where FEDFUNDS has fallen by more than 0.25 percentage points in the past 3 months and CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of tight labor market conditions (UNRATE < 4.0%), the economy is expanding with strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day windows where UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 60-day windows where INDPRO is above 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts above 1200.0 (thousands of units) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 5-day windows where HOUST is above 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200.0 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1.5%, the market perceives a strong economy with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 60-day windows where HOUST is above 1200.0 and FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 108.0), the economy is expanding robustly, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 5-day windows where INDPRO is above 108.0.
